sourceFile: 19. BRS-201506 Report checking and test problem NG function high date 24.2.2024 -_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are overmerged and not reliable for final evidence.
issues: Changed factor concatenates unrelated tests and dates.
Baseline and test conditions are ambiguous or mixed.
Multiple reports and domains are merged into one case.
Measurement parsing includes non-metric values and corrupt stats.
Several outcomes are unjudged yet tied to one factor.
correctionPlan: Split by report or clear validation objective.
Create separate factors for UV block, coil change, VP KR, mold/cavity, and dimensions.
Keep date, lot, cavity, machine, and test round as subgroup keys.
Rebuild comparisons only from adjacent table rows with shared headers.
Remove corrupt measurement stats and unjudged unrelated outcomes.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but do not sufficiently support the current grouping.
